invariants.rationale: A valid commit instant time is usually required; code likely expects a non-null string.
A non-null input map is generally expected for committing records.
Commits typically only proceed if there are records to commit, so the map should not be empty.
A non-empty string for instant time is likely required for tracking commit instants.
Partition keys in the map should be valid, non-null and non-empty strings.
